quizzes.question: Which verse teaches us to be still and trust that God is in control?

options.simplified: Be calm and recognize God's sovereignty
options.text: Be still and know that I am God

options.simplified: We can accomplish anything through Christ's strength
options.text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me

options.simplified: Jesus offers rest to the exhausted
options.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened

options.simplified: Don't be afraid because God is always with you
options.text: Be strong and courageous... the Lord your God will be with you

quizzes.explanation: Psalm 46:10 is God's call to stop striving and trust in His sovereignty. It reminds us to pause and remember who God is.

quizzes.question: Which verse is known as the 'Gospel in a nutshell' about God's love?

options.simplified: God loved the world so much He sent Jesus to save us
options.text: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son

options.simplified: Everything works together for the good of believers
options.text: In all things God works for the good of those who love him

options.simplified: Love is patient and kind
options.text: Love is patient, love is kind

options.simplified: God's very nature is love
options.text: God is love

quizzes.explanation: John 3:16 is perhaps the most well-known verse in the Bible, summarizing the entire gospel message of salvation through faith in Jesus.

quizzes.question: Which verse promises that God has good plans for your future?

options.simplified: God has plans to prosper you and give you hope
options.text: For I know the plans I have for you... plans to give you hope and a future

options.simplified: Trust God completely and He will guide your path
options.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart... and he will make your paths straight

options.simplified: Everything works out for believers' good
options.text: In all things God works for the good of those who love him

options.simplified: Those who trust God will be renewed in strength
options.text: Those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength

quizzes.explanation: Jeremiah 29:11 was originally spoken to exiled Israelites, but it applies to all believers - God has purposeful, hope-filled plans for His people.

quizzes.question: Which verse describes what true love looks like?

options.simplified: Love is patient, kind, not envious, not boastful, and keeps no record of wrongs
options.text: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast...

options.simplified: God demonstrated His love by sending Jesus
options.text: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son

options.simplified: The greatest love is sacrificing your life for friends
options.text: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one's life for one's friends

options.simplified: God showed His love by Christ dying for sinners
options.text: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us

quizzes.explanation: 1 Corinthians 13 is often called the 'Love Chapter' and defines what biblical, agape love truly looks like in action.

quizzes.question: Which verse promises God's presence wherever you go?

options.simplified: Be courageous because God is with you everywhere
options.text: Be strong and courageous... for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go

options.simplified: Jesus promises to be with us always, until the end
options.text: And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age

options.simplified: You cannot go anywhere away from God's Spirit
options.text: Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence?

options.simplified: God will never leave or abandon you
options.text: The Lord your God... will never leave you nor forsake you

quizzes.explanation: God spoke these words to Joshua as he was about to lead Israel into the Promised Land. It's a powerful reminder of God's constant presence.

quizzes.question: Which verse tells us to trust God instead of our own understanding?

options.simplified: Trust God completely, not your own wisdom, and He'll direct you
options.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding

options.simplified: Be still and recognize God's authority
options.text: Be still and know that I am God

options.simplified: God's ways are higher than human ways
options.text: As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways

options.simplified: Ask God for wisdom and He'll give it generously
options.text: If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God

quizzes.explanation: Proverbs 3:5-6 is a foundational verse about faith - trusting God's wisdom over our limited human understanding.

quizzes.question: Which verse compares God to a shepherd who provides everything?

options.simplified: The Lord is my shepherd, so I have everything I need
options.text: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing

options.simplified: Jesus is the good shepherd who dies for His sheep
options.text: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep

options.simplified: God will supply all your needs from His riches
options.text: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory

options.simplified: God feeds the birds, so surely He'll care for you
options.text: Look at the birds of the air... your heavenly Father feeds them

quizzes.explanation: Psalm 23 is one of the most beloved psalms, using the shepherd metaphor to describe God's tender care and provision.

quizzes.question: Which verse promises that everything works together for believers' good?

options.simplified: God works all circumstances for the good of those who love Him
options.text: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him

options.simplified: God has prosperous plans for your future
options.text: For I know the plans I have for you... plans to give you hope and a future

options.simplified: God will complete the good work He started in you
options.text: He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion

options.simplified: Every good gift comes from God
options.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above

quizzes.explanation: Romans 8:28 is a powerful promise that God sovereignly orchestrates all events for the ultimate good of His children.

quizzes.question: Which verse teaches about not worrying and trusting God for provision?

options.simplified: Don't worry about life; God feeds the birds and will care for you too
options.text: Do not worry about your life... Look at the birds of the air

options.simplified: Don't be anxious; pray about everything with thanksgiving
options.text: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer

options.simplified: Give all your worries to God because He cares for you
options.text: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you

options.simplified: Give your burdens to the Lord and He'll sustain you
options.text: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you

quizzes.explanation: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus uses birds and flowers as examples of how God provides for His creation, teaching us not to worry.

quizzes.question: Which verse describes the Word of God as living and active?

options.simplified: God's Word is alive, powerful, and sharper than any sword
options.text: For the word of God is alive and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword

options.simplified: All Scripture is inspired by God and useful for teaching
options.text: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching

options.simplified: God's Word is a lamp and light guiding our path
options.text: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path

options.simplified: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was God
options.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God

quizzes.explanation: Hebrews 4:12 describes Scripture as living and active - not just historical words, but God's ongoing communication that penetrates our hearts.

quizzes.question: Which verse commands us to love our enemies?

options.simplified: Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you
options.text: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you

options.simplified: If your enemy is hungry, feed them
options.text: If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink

options.simplified: Give food and water to your enemy
options.text: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat

options.simplified: Do good to those who hate you
options.text: Do good to those who hate you

quizzes.explanation: In the Sermon on the Mount, Jesus radically redefines love - not just loving those who love us, but even our enemies.

quizzes.question: Which verse promises God will never leave or forsake you?

options.simplified: God will never leave you or abandon you
options.text: Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you

options.simplified: Be strong; God goes with you and won't abandon you
options.text: The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you

options.simplified: Don't be afraid because God is with you everywhere
options.text: For the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go

options.simplified: Don't fear because God is with you
options.text: Do not fear, for I am with you

quizzes.explanation: Hebrews quotes this Old Testament promise, reassuring believers that God's faithful presence is permanent and unchanging.

quizzes.question: Which verse teaches that we should not conform to the world's patterns?

options.simplified: Don't copy the world; let God transform your mind
options.text: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind

options.simplified: Don't love the world or its things
options.text: Do not love the world or anything in the world

options.text: Friendship with the world means enmity against God

options.simplified: Focus your mind on heavenly things, not earthly ones
options.text: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things

quizzes.explanation: Romans 12:2 calls believers to think differently from the world, being transformed by God rather than shaped by culture.

quizzes.question: Which verse promises rest for the weary?

options.simplified: Come to Jesus if you're tired, and He'll give you rest
options.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest

options.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters

options.simplified: God's presence goes with you and gives rest
options.text: My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest

options.simplified: Find rest in God alone
options.text: Truly my soul finds rest in God

quizzes.explanation: Jesus invites all who are exhausted from striving to come to Him for true, soul-deep rest.

quizzes.question: Which verse teaches that faith without works is dead?

options.simplified: Just as a body without spirit is dead, faith without action is dead
options.text: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead

options.simplified: Salvation is by grace through faith, not by works
options.text: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith... not by works

options.text: The only thing that counts is faith expressing itself through love

options.simplified: Love with actions, not just words
options.text: Let us not love with words or speech but with actions and in truth

quizzes.explanation: James emphasizes that genuine faith naturally produces good works - not to earn salvation, but as evidence of real faith.

quizzes.question: Which verse tells us we are God's masterpiece?

options.simplified: We are God's handiwork, created to do good works
options.text: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works

options.simplified: God created humans in His own image
options.text: So God created mankind in his own image

options.text: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood

quizzes.explanation: Paul reminds believers they are God's workmanship (or 'masterpiece' in some translations), created with purpose.

quizzes.question: Which verse says we can do all things through Christ?

options.simplified: I can do everything through Christ who strengthens me
options.text: I can do all this through him who gives me strength

options.simplified: God's power is perfected in weakness
options.text: My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness

options.simplified: Those who hope in God will renew their strength
options.text: But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength

quizzes.explanation: Paul wrote this from prison, not claiming he could do anything he wanted, but that Christ's strength sustains him in all circumstances.

quizzes.question: Which verse commands us to be kind and forgive one another?

options.simplified: Be kind and compassionate, forgiving each other as God forgave you
options.text: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you

quizzes.explanation: Paul links our forgiveness of others to God's forgiveness of us - we forgive because we've been forgiven.

quizzes.question: Which verse says perfect love drives out fear?

options.text: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear

options.simplified: Don't fear because God is with you
options.text: So do not fear, for I am with you

quizzes.explanation: John explains that when we truly understand God's love, fear loses its grip because we trust His perfect love.

quizzes.question: Which verse describes the armor of God?

options.simplified: Put aside darkness and put on the armor of light
options.text: So let us put aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light

options.simplified: We use weapons of righteousness
options.text: In truthful speech and in the power of God; with weapons of righteousness

quizzes.explanation: Paul uses military imagery to describe the spiritual resources God provides for spiritual warfare.

quizzes.question: Which verse teaches that God's grace is sufficient?

options.text: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith

quizzes.question: Which verse promises renewal like the eagle's?

options.text: Who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's

options.text: Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day

quizzes.question: Which verse says Jesus is the way, the truth, and the life?

quizzes.question: Which verse promises a crown of life to those who persevere?

options.text: Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up

options.text: We take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ

options.simplified: Be transformed by renewing your mind
options.text: Be transformed by the renewing of your mind

options.simplified: Set your minds on things above
options.text: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things

quizzes.explanation: Paul teaches spiritual warfare includes controlling our thoughts and aligning them with Christ's truth.

quizzes.question: Which verse promises that God began a good work in you and will complete it?

options.text: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it

options.simplified: God is able to keep you from stumbling
options.text: To him who is able to keep you from stumbling

quizzes.explanation: Paul assures believers that God doesn't abandon His work in us - He faithfully completes what He starts.

quizzes.question: Which verse says God's Word is a lamp to our feet?

options.simplified: Your word lights my path like a lamp
options.text: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path

options.simplified: Commands are a lamp and teaching is a light

options.text: You, Lord, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light

quizzes.question: Which verse teaches that Jesus came not to be served but to serve?

quizzes.question: Which verse promises that nothing can separate us from God's love?

quizzes.question: Which verse commands us to honor our parents?

options.simplified: The one who sins is the one who will die
options.text: The one who sins is the one who will die

quizzes.explanation: Paul contrasts sin's consequence (death) with God's free gift (eternal life), summarizing the gospel message.

quizzes.question: Which verse says the righteous will live by faith?

options.simplified: The righteous person will live by their faithfulness
options.text: But the righteous person will live by his faithfulness

options.simplified: The righteous will live by faith
options.text: For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed—a righteousness that is by faith from first to last, just as it is written: 'The righteous will live by faith'

options.simplified: No one is justified before God by the law; the righteous live by faith
options.text: Clearly no one who relies on the law is justified before God, because 'the righteous will live by faith'

options.simplified: My righteous one will live by faith
options.text: But my righteous one will live by faith

quizzes.explanation: This Old Testament verse became foundational for Paul's teaching on justification by faith, quoted multiple times in the New Testament.

quizzes.question: Which verse promises that God will supply all your needs?

options.simplified: God will meet all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ
options.text: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus

options.simplified: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing
options.text: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing

options.simplified: Seek God's kingdom first and all these things will be given to you
options.text: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well

options.simplified: God feeds the ravens; how much more valuable you are!
options.text: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap... yet God feeds them. And how much more valuable you are than birds!

quizzes.explanation: Paul thanks the Philippians for their support and assures them that God, who is infinitely rich, will provide for them.
